product: indie hiking boots, made in small Vermont batches
tone: earnest, slightly off-kilter, documentary — never cynical, never bro-y, never "crushing it"
target_audience: weekend hikers in their 30s-40s who treat their gear like heirlooms, not status objects
brand_style: 16mm film, naturalistic light, hands-and-laces close-ups. Pacific Northwest / Northeast hardwoods, fog, wet stone. Muted forest palette with one warm leather highlight. Documentary stillness — NOT triumphant orchestral, NOT slow-motion hero shots, NOT mountain-vista wide-angles. Real feet, real mud, real wear. 16:9.
